scientific_question: Does a separately compiled, evidence-ranked and geographically localized European butterfly host inventory expose important botanical host-link missingness or false confidence in the frozen global butterfly HOSTS resource reconstruction?

source.paper: Clarke H E (2024) A checklist of European butterfly larval foodplants, Ecology and Evolution 14:e10834; DOI 10.1002/ece3.10834
source.required: Read original source tables AND README; preserve source taxonomic identifiers, evidence status, locality and publication references.
source.source_access: Attempt original file_stream then canonical Dryad API file endpoint for each approved file; an alternative author-deposited copy or PMC appendix is acceptable only after provenance reconciliation, never substitute scraped names silently.

design.host_list: Pinned globalbioticinteractions/HOSTS commit 808e0b869f9ec1adf8efff87cf6a395adda103e0 + WCVP rWCVPdata commit 65bed76bae9d644ccb6ad200c05f9f5071d89e05
design.taxonomic_join: Exact accepted species binomial for butterflies, unique WCVP accepted plant identity or exact unequivocal normalized accepted binomial, no genus-level imputation, no hidden synonym aggregation. Report unmatched denominator.
design.source_independence: Independently COMPILED checklist, not guaranteed source-observation independent of HOSTS or WCVP. Quantify overlapping citations where possible before claiming independent empirical validation.
design.primary: Among exact butterfly matches and evidence<=3 exact plant species, fraction with/without corresponding exact frozen HOSTS butterfly-host link. Report species count, host pair count, and per-butterfly missed-link count; do not calculate an uncorrected global missing-link fraction.
design.quality_control: Report mistakenly accepted status=6, status unknown, infraspecific taxa, names with ambiguity; exclude missing or conflicting evidence. Separate endemic native European butterflies from introduced populations if origins known.
design.next_gate: Only if source tables and stable joins succeed: evaluate whether adding high-evidence missing host species changes native vs contemporary regional resource envelope, preserving existing 239 GEB panel as frozen comparator, post-hoc sensitivity only.

stop: If source download unavailable, record exact HTTP failures; no reconstructed statistics.
If synonym crosswalk or status semantics uncertain, stop without inferred links.
If >25% taxon matches ambiguous, report feasibility and do not proceed to biological outcome.
Do not fit fitness, colonization, causal globalization or interspecific competition from bibliography-only host records.
No change to main GEB manuscript, figures or frozen claim map based on exploratory audit alone.
